zh: 活动不能重排，每周是一段连续区间，而且必须恰好分成weeks段。想一想最后一周覆盖的是哪一段。
设dp[w][i]为前i个活动分成w周的最小总投入。最后一周是某个后缀cost[j..i−1]，于是dp[w][i]=min(dp[w−1][j]+这一段的最大值)。n≤300，O(weeks·n²)足够快。
初始dp[0][0]=0，其余为无穷大。对每个w和每个i≥w，让j从i−1向左走到w−1，一边走一边维护区间最大值并取最小的转移。只需保留上一层数组，答案为dp[weeks][n]。
en: Activities cannot be reordered, each week is a contiguous range, and there must be exactly weeks ranges. Think about which range the last week covers.

Let dp[w][i] be the minimum total effort for splitting the first i activities into w weeks. The last week is some suffix cost[j..i−1], so dp[w][i]=min(dp[w−1][j] + the maximum of that range). With n≤300, O(weeks·n²) is fast enough.

Start with dp[0][0]=0 and infinity everywhere else. For each w and each i≥w, move j from i−1 leftward down to w−1, maintaining the running range maximum as you go and taking the minimum transition. Only the previous layer needs to be kept; the answer is dp[weeks][n].

explanationEn:
## Approach

dp[w][i] is the minimum total effort for splitting the first i activities into w weeks. Enumerate the start j of the last week and transition with dp[w−1][j]+max(cost[j:i]). Maintain the range maximum while enumerating j leftward, and roll over the week layers.

## Proof of correctness

In any valid plan the last week is a non-empty suffix, and everything before it is split into exactly w−1 weeks; if the earlier part were not optimal, replacing it would lower the total cost. Enumerating every j covers every last split point, and w≤j+1 guarantees that no week is empty. Starting from cost 0 for 0 items in 0 weeks and infinity elsewhere, induction gives the required optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(weeks·n²), space O(n).
